answer: Pay agents only from client-signed receipts, and cap each client's per-epoch spend at its locked deposit: a hard budget horizon enforced by protocol. Every receipt burns a fee. Masks sprout as easily as willow cuttings around one lotus pool, yet N masks serving one client split that client's single budget; funding fake clients yourself just recycles your tokens through the burn, losing a slice per pass. Fake earnings thus cost more than they return and extra identities add nothing. Risk: colluding wealthy clients.
